description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: This work was produced inside an AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Every claim is backed by a timestamped, publicly committed receipt trail in the four-horsemen repository. Errors are disclosed, not erased. Limitations are load-bearing.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects. All battery payloads are synthetic.

On Oct 16 2026, HACK Wave 1 — three preregistered adversarial batteries against NIST-style and NSA-style attack classes — was executed against the SQUIRL OS deterministic gates under a preregistration frozen and committed BEFORE any run (freeze commit fc6e96f: specs, harnesses, and the Wave 2+ roadmap). Deterministic adjudication; no LLM in the decision path; all injections synthetic and hub-local. Eighteen preregistered falsifiers:

HACK-8 — NIST SP 800-90B/C Entropy Validation ("True Audit", 6/6 PASS, receipt 60bb6d35...6f3b3): the government's own answer to BULLRUN turned adversarial. Dual_EC-style subverted DRBG rejected off-allowlist; keygen refused at 47-bit starved entropy; classical downgrade rejected (allowlist frozen: CRYSTALS-Dilithium3, kyber_1024, SPHINCS+-256f); nonce replay rejected on second use; biased DRBG output quarantined by health test; entropy state tamper + in-band "emergency override" claim rejected.

HACK-9 — NSA IRATE MONK Boot Tamper (6/6 PASS, receipt e2732fa6...4189): firmware and boot-path persistence against the SHA-receipted base image. Image SHA divergence refuses boot, fail closed; an injected "skip verification" bootloader flag is structurally ignored — verification is unconditional; an initrd backdoor write is denied (no write path on the frozen manifest surface); a snapshot rollback resurrecting retired key TX-LEGACY-7 is refused by ledger sequence-regression detection (128 <= head 135); forged firmware attestation without a receipt chain is rejected; a runtime "deity bounce" emergency-override demand is refused — in-band claims carry no authority.

HACK-10 — NSA QUANTUM On-Path Injection (6/6 PASS, receipt 53820065...709f): the channel class the series had not yet touched. Mid-transit payload modification refused — no journaled crossing, no state change (H-INV-2); a forged "authorized update" from a non-owner identity refused by the sender gate; packet replay refused (single-use nonces); a timing race of conflicting updates resolved by a deterministic (sequence, sha) tiebreak — exactly one applied, one rejected, both journaled; a channel downgrade demand refused (PQC mandatory); injected fake "all verified OK" telemetry refused by ledger re-computation (false-green guard).

Result: 18/18 PASS, zero violations, zero critical holds. The same freeze commit also preregisters the Wave 2+ roadmap (FOXACID, MUSCULAR, Hive/Vault 7, EDGEHILL, NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust, NIST AI RMF, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3) — each with its own full spec + freeze commit before its run.

What this receipt establishes (scoped): the entropy, boot, and channel surfaces of THIS hub hold against these preregistered attack classes under THESE conditions — randomness is validated at the gate fail-closed; boot verification is unconditional; authority derives only from the authenticated owner account; state changes require journaled crossings. Not a security claim for arbitrary attack surfaces outside the governed boundary.
